notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
